rows.title: Memento 2000, directed by Christopher Nolan | Film review
rows.comment: ingenious thriller displays real interest in how perception and memory shape action
rows.verdict_le10: ingenious thriller displays real interest in how perception and memory shape action
rows.dek_lead: This taut, ingenious thriller displays real interest in how perception and memory shape action, identity and, of course, filmic storytelling. Moreover, a plot strand featuring Stephen Tobolowsky even touches the heart.
